::: {#exm-symmetric-or-not}
#### Symmetric or not

- The relation $T$ of @exm-shares-letter is symmetric (@def-symmetric-relation):
  if $a$ has a letter in common with $b$, then $b$ has the same letter in common with $a$.
- The relation $B$ of @exm-beats is not symmetric:
  rock beats scissors, but scissors does not beat rock.
- The relation $P$ of @exm-parent is not symmetric:
  Ada is a parent of Ben, but Ben is not a parent of Ada.

:::
